justification: Multi-file bug fixes across 3 API routes and 1 Python DB function. Affects data correctness for DCP provisions, heritage lookup, and setback filtering. Not Critical because fixes existing bugs, no new legal output or payment paths.

pre_impl.existing_data: heritage_conservation_areas (2039 IW rows, lga_name UPPER CASE), dcp_general_requirements (former_council column), dcp_setback_controls (1037 rows, applicability + condition columns)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: LGA case mismatch causes silent 0-row returns (heritage). Null formerCouncil causes wrong council data served (DCP). Missing zone filter causes irrelevant controls included (setbacks).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All fixes are query-time behavior — applies to all requests immediately, no data migration needed.

functions.name: DCP-complete handler (null council path)
functions.input: formerCouncil: string|null from PostGIS spatial query + address fallback
functions.output: JSON response with empty arrays + council_detection_failed metadata
functions.if_none: Returns empty result with metadata flag instead of wrong Marrickville data

functions.name: HCA check handler (lga normalisation)
functions.output: lga: string uppercased for heritage_conservation_areas.lga_name match
functions.if_none: Ternary guard passes null through — DB query returns 0 rows, inHCA: false

functions.name: fetch_dcp_setbacks
functions.input: zone_code: Optional[str] from caller (e.g. 'R2 Low Density Residential')
functions.output: Filtered setback rows excluding zone-specific controls for different zones
functions.if_none: zone_prefix = '' — filter skipped, all rows returned (preserves existing behavior)

values.guard_at: dcp-complete/route.ts:898 — returns empty result with metadata
values.if_missing: Empty DCP requirements with council_detection_failed: true

values.guard_at: hca-check/route.ts:108 — ternary null guard on toUpperCase()
values.if_missing: null passed to DB, 0 rows, inHCA: false (safe default)

values.guard_at: conveyancing_db.py:207 — conditional expression with if zone_code else empty
values.if_missing: Empty string, zone filter skipped, all controls returned

values.guard_at: conveyancing_db.py:211 — must equal zone_specific AND condition must be truthy

queries.purpose: Heritage HCA bbox check with normalised LGA
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga_name = $1 (now uppercased) AND bbox filters
queries.if_wrong: Extra bbox candidates filtered by ray casting (safe)

queries.purpose: DCP setback fetch with zone advisory filter
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga = %s AND is_current = TRUE (unchanged). Zone filter applied post-fetch in Python.
queries.if_wrong: is_current = TRUE prevents inactive rows. Zone filter is conservative, only excludes explicit mismatches.

break_it.scenario: Address in Inner West, no suburb match, no precinct boundary match, formerCouncil stays null
break_it.what_happens: Previously: wrong Marrickville data served silently. Now: empty result with council_detection_failed metadata.
break_it.how: dcp-complete/route.ts:898-908 — explicit empty return with metadata flag
break_it.repro: POST /api/compliance/dcp-complete with address outside all precinct boundaries but within Inner West LGA

break_it.scenario: Frontend sends lga: 'inner west' (lowercase) to HCA check endpoint
break_it.what_happens: Previously: 0 rows from WHERE lga_name = 'inner west' (DB stores INNER WEST). Now: toUpperCase() converts correctly.
break_it.repro: POST /api/heritage/hca-check with lga: 'inner west' and valid Inner West coordinates

break_it.scenario: Zone-specific setback condition 'R4 High Density' presented to R2 user, should be excluded
break_it.what_happens: zone_prefix = R2, condition mentions R4 zone code, R2 not in condition text, row skipped (correct).
break_it.how: conveyancing_db.py:214-215 — substring match checks if user's zone is present in condition text
break_it.repro: Call fetch_dcp_setbacks('woollahra', 'R2') and verify R4-specific controls are excluded

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — test HCA check with lowercase LGA param; test DCP-complete for address outside precinct boundaries
